title: On Suggesting a shorter route north
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：suggest　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suggest 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the doctor ① suggested a shorter route north in silence, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② suggests a shorter route north twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ suggest a shorter route north at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ suggested a shorter route north before — a line in the chart for January 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Suggesting a shorter route north in silence, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ suggest that the plan was unsafe twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Suggest that the plan was unsafe at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ suggests that the plan was unsafe in silence every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ suggested a shorter route north again when nobody else would.

⑩ To suggest a shorter route north, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody suggests a shorter route north twice over again and somebody must suggest a shorter route north in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 建议（一般过去式 suggested a shorter route north：1966 年大夫头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 建议（一般现在 suggests a shorter route north：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 建议（不定式 to suggest a shorter route north：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 建议（过去完成时 had suggested a shorter route north：1960 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 建议（动名词 suggesting a shorter route north 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 暗示（suggest that the plan was unsafe：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去暗示暗示那套方案并不稳妥）
G. v. 暗示（suggest that the plan was unsafe：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 建议（后段两处：新来的病人照例 suggests that the plan was unsafe，而母亲又一次 suggested a shorter route north）

answers.why: suggest 意为“建议”，1966 年大夫一言不发地建议建议走北边那条短路，那是卫生所里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 suggested。
suggest 意为“建议”，自那以后大夫来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 suggests。
suggest 意为“建议”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯建议建议走北边那条短路”，此处为不定式 to suggest a shorter route north。
suggest 意为“建议”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人建议过，故用过去完成时 had suggested。
suggest 意为“建议”，大夫说“建议建议走北边那条短路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 suggesting a shorter route north 作主语。
suggest 意为“暗示”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去暗示暗示那套方案并不稳妥”，should ever 之后用原形 suggest that the plan was unsafe。
suggest 意为“暗示”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻暗示暗示那套方案并不稳妥（suggest that the plan was unsafe at once），以后再也不要提起。
suggest 意为“建议”，新来的病人每个星期都照例暗示暗示那套方案并不稳妥，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 suggests。
suggest 意为“建议”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地建议建议走北边那条短路，用一般过去式 suggested 叙述。
suggest 意为“建议”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要建议建议走北边那条短路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 suggest 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the doctor suggested a shorter route north in silence, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor suggests a shorter route north twice over whenever the clinic asks.
Suggesting a shorter route north in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever suggest that the plan was unsafe twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic suggests that the plan was unsafe in silence every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother suggested a shorter route north again, and the clinic remembered that half.
